messages.content:
What is asked:
<data>
Run-length encoding of a list of natural numbers. Every maximal run of equal neighbours becomes one pair: the value, and how long the run is. The pairs stand in the order of the runs.
</data>

The name and the signature:
<data>
def runLengths (l : List Nat) : List (Nat × Nat)
</data>

Constraints:
<data>
- Recursion on the structure of the list: no well-founded recursion and no partial definition.
- Nothing beyond the Lean core library.
</data>

Examples it has to get right:
<data>
runLengths [1, 1, 2, 3, 3, 3]  should give  [(1, 2), (2, 1), (3, 3)]
runLengths []  should give  []
runLengths [7]  should give  [(7, 1)]
runLengths [4, 4, 4, 4]  should give  [(4, 4)]
(runLengths [5, 5, 6, 5]).length  should give  3
</data>
